description: Expanding a string after a successful argument of try makes the call fail
notes: The README says try evaluates its argument expressions in order until one produces a result without errors, so try(1, "x"...) would give 1. The native syntax spec says the expression before ... must evaluate to a list or tuple, and neither says whether that is checked before try runs. hashicorp/hcl checks it before calling the function (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so try never runs.
reference_error: must be of a tuple, list, or set type
